description: This file contains the implementation of LoggingAdvice, an aspect-oriented programming class that intercepts method calls within the OpenMRS service layer to log method execution details such as arguments, execution time, and errors. It uses SLF4J for logging and annotations to control logging behavior.

classes.name: LoggingAdvice
classes.description: A class providing AOP logging around advice for service layer methods in OpenMRS, intercepting method calls to log details based on method type and annotations.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Intercepts method invocations to log method entry, arguments, execution time, and exceptions, according to method type and annotations.
